banner.title: Refund Policy
banner.description: Monthly plan payments, cancellations and purchase support.

paragraphs.text: Completed monthly plan payments are non-refundable, including if you change your mind, use only part of your plan, or cancel during a paid month. This policy applies to PM Circle’s monthly subscription plans.

You can cancel at any time. To avoid the next charge on a renewing plan, cancel before the next renewal date. You can continue using your paid features until the end of the period you have already paid for. Cancellation does not generate a prorated refund.
If you need help cancelling, contact PM Circle support through ITQAN Consulting.
paragraphs.linkLabel: contact PM Circle support through ITQAN Consulting

paragraphs.text: If you were charged but your plan did not activate, you cannot access the features you paid for, or you see a billing error, report the issue. Include your account email, payment date and order or transaction reference. We will check the payment and resolve any confirmed billing or activation issue.
Any refund or other remedy required by applicable law remains available. See the Terms and Conditions for more on purchases and plan access.
